actualVisualInspection.method: Root physically viewed both active RIGHT and LEFT source sheets and adopts the independent physically viewed Teliko Acid1 official reference comparison.

limits: Exact source-only job approval, not GUI/installation/Git/runtime/production admission.
Original fan transformation tied to its canonical incarnation, not an official retail costume or absolute1:1 certificate.
Geometry masks measured at alpha>16; low-alpha fringes unclaimed. Manual pelvis/neutral datums are visual source measurements, not physical metre/anatomical certificates.
Original fighter, source sprite, frame clocks, phase maps, gameplay parameters and historical display height remain preserved.
Teliko is the adult Metal Gear Acid1 incarnation, silver bob, personal pistols/card codes; not Venus or an era merge. This is a Dite survival fan adaptation.
RIGHT first atlas row uses its actual upright345 witness and remaining rows actual286; LEFT uses actual325. These are page/band constants, not per-pose resizing.
LEFT passing support appears on the rear toe rather than a flat sole. A drawn toe support is not automatically impossible; real world floor/gait and relative alignment must pass UI before admission.
Super remains the actual card4/optic16 release. No new laser or changed projectile kind is invented.
